name: Mahfi Eğilmez
detail: Published comprehensive essay arguing that due to Turkey's high informality, taxing registered wealth penalizes compliant taxpayers and evokes 1942 Varlık Vergisi memories; recommends expenditure audits instead.

name: Ergün Atalay
detail: President of Türk-İş. Campaigns for tax justice ('az kazanandan az, çok kazanandan çok vergi') and income tax reform, but does not propose a net wealth tax.

name: Erkan Baş
detail: Chairman of TİP. In TBMM speeches advocates general progressive taxation ('zenginlerden daha fazla vergi alınmalıdır') without naming net wealth tax in his own spoken remarks; TİP party organization is included under party resolution.

name: Bağımsızlık Yolu
detail: Socialist party advocating a wealth tax (Servet Vergisi), but based in and organized solely within Northern Cyprus (TRNC), outside the jurisdiction of Turkey.

name: Türkiye Komünist Partisi
detail: Communist Party of Turkey (TKP). In party programs and statements advocates complete expropriation and nationalization of capitalist wealth and abolition of capitalist property rather than an annual net wealth tax reform.

name: İzzettin Önder
detail: Emeritus Professor of Public Finance at Istanbul University. Endorses socialist systemic transformation but argues against a net wealth tax within globalized financial capitalism, asserting that mobile capital would cause economic shock and that piecemeal tax reforms cannot solve structural exploitation.

name: Sera Kadıgil
detail: Spokesperson and Member of Parliament for TİP (Workers' Party of Turkey). In TBMM floor speeches passionately attacks wealth transfer to capital ('devleti servet transferinin aracı kurumu haline getirenler') and campaigns for tax justice, but has not personally named or proposed a wealth tax bill (party organization is included).

name: Süleyman Girgin
detail: Former CHP MP for Muğla, former Maden-İş president. In his 31 Oct 2019 Plan and Budget Commission speech on the accommodation tax he argues for a tax system built on direct taxes (the quote only lists wealth tax among the direct taxes of developed countries) and never calls for a wealth tax himself.
